topics.name: Canonical Repository Conformance Profile
topics.purpose: Define repository-wide conformance rules over Contract Format, identities, references, ownership, status/readiness, source roles and required projections.

semantics.identity_rule: Each conformance profile has explicit identity/version.
semantics.scope_rule: Profile applies to exact repository/version/branch/package scope.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown required check prevents compliant result.
semantics.projection_rule: Derived projection consistency can be checked without making projections authoritative.
semantics.authority_rule: Conformance pass does not deploy runtime.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: conformance inferred from no parser crash
profile selected by branch name heuristically
